"A resizeable array of toggleable lights with logic. When input numbers surpass 10.0, the colors of the rainbow start to appear."

The LCD is a structure that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It can display up to 64 individual lights in a grid.

Functionality

The LCD is a logical component that displays 1 to 64 lights in a 1×1 to 8×8 resizable grid.

To change the color on the LCD, a Number Interface is required. Connect the Number Interface to the LCD and change the value of the Number Interface to change the color of the LCD; values range from 1 to 100. A single color has a range of 10 available shades, with 1 being the darkest the color and 10 being the brightest a color. The colors are mapped as follows:

Color table
Color Value
White 1-10
Red 11-20
Orange 21-30
Yellow 31-40
Green 41-50
Blue 51-60
Cyan 61-70
Pink 71-80
Purple 81-90
Silver 91-100
